note:
R89 - the `ABKC` bank tree (the region between the file header and the S10A sample table) as a read / selection / stream-address
contract, measured on every loose `.abk` of the X360 NHL 10-Legacy and PS3 NHL 11 / 14 / 15 / Legacy trees (11 trees). Read-only.

Grammar under test (derived on PS3 NHL 15 `horns.abk` / `000_goal.abk` / `000_chant.abk` / `playercalls.abk` / `crowds.abk` / `sfx.abk`,
then tested on every bank of every tree):
  header  'ABKC' | u32 0x01010300 | u32 w08 (byte 0 = platform code: 0x0a PS3, 0x05 X360; low u16 = count of 0x68-byte "handler"
          nodes that start at tree_start + 8) | ... | 0x14 file size | 0x18 sample-table offset | 0x1c tree start (0x78 PS3, 0x5c X360)
          | 0x20 table offset again | 0x24 table data size | 0x2c stream-file id (== the sibling `.ast` u32 at 4) | 0x30 A | 0x34 B | 0x38 C
  tail    A: u32 count + count x u32 (always 0 on the measured banks)
          B: u32 count + count x u32 LOC - a pointer-fixup table: the u32 at LOC + 4 is a file-absolute offset of another node inside
             the tree region [tree_start, table)
          C: u32 count + count x { u32 node (file-absolute) | u32 name (file-absolute; u32 hash then a NUL-terminated string, padded
             to 4) | u32 flags (byte 0 = class 0 `_snd` / 1 `h_` / 2 `_msg`; low 24 bits constant per bank) }
  nodes   a pointer target whose first byte is 0 and whose u32 count fits 12-byte entries up to the table is a SAMPLE LIST:
             entry = u16 sample index (S10A record) | u8 weight (100 / 90 seen) | u16 X | u24 S | u32 O
             O = file offset of the stream in the sibling `.ast` (stream records) or 0xFFFFFFFF (ram records)
  .ast    'S10S' | u32 id | zeros to 0x40 | blocks { u8 flags | u24 size | u32 samples | payload }: PS3 contiguous; a block with
          flag 0x80 is the LAST block of a stream; streams tile from 0x40. Loop-type stream records (16-byte records, words a / b)
          point at a one-block stub whose (samples, size) == (a, b); the loop body is the next, otherwise unreferenced, stream.
Tests per bank: T1 every S10A record index appears in exactly one sample-list entry (count of entries == records; no duplicates);
  T2 every stream entry's O is a stream start of the `.ast` (and every ram entry's O is 0xFFFFFFFF); T3 for every non-loop stream entry
  the sum of the stream's block sample words == the record's num_samples; T4 every loop stream record: stub (samples, size) == (a, b)
  and stub samples + next stream's samples == num_samples; T5 header 0x2c == `.ast` word 4; T6 every B pointer target lies inside the
  tree region; every C node / name lies inside the tree region / the tail; T7 every sample list is referenced from inside the extent of
  a named node (the owner = the sound / picker name); T8 `.ast` streams not referenced by any entry are exactly the loop bodies.
Controls (one bank per tree, in memory): a B pointer moved beyond the table -> refused (T6); a sample-list count + 1 -> refused (T1 or
  bounds); one stream O + 4 -> refused (T2). Shared-reference census: records referenced by > 1 entry, lists owned by > 1 named node.
Usage: python r89_abk_bank_tree.py <out.json> [tree ...]
